summary: AMTD Digital Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching an announcement by its subsidiary, The Generation Essentials Group (TGE), of a share repurchase program. TGE's board approved up to $10 million in open-market or negotiated repurchases, funded from existing cash, under Rule 10b-18/10b5-1. Concurrently, controlling shareholder AMTD Digital, directors and management voluntarily locked up their shares for two years. No premium or per-share price stated. The filing highlights TGE's belief its shares trade at a deep discount to net asset value (~$971M). What to watch: pace of buybacks and potential NAV convergence.
